rabbitmq.role: Local AMQP broker with management UI under the rabbitmq Compose profile.
rabbitmq.verified_source: Docker Official Image supported tag list

aio-pika.role: Primary maintained asyncio AMQP 0-9-1 convenience client for RabbitMQ; AMQP concepts remain library-independent.

aiormq.role: Resolved lower-level asynchronous AMQP client used by aio-pika.

anyio.role: Structured async runtime used by Starlette/testing.

grpcio-tools.role: Protobuf code generation; latest verified tools release at packaging.

httpx.role: Stable HTTP client and ASGI testing; 1.0 development releases excluded.

pytest-asyncio.role: Optional asyncio test compatibility; AnyIO plugin remains primary for many examples.

python.role: Canonical runtime; examples retain Python 3.11 alternatives where useful.

starlette.role: Verified current release; resolved through FastAPI rather than pinned as a direct dependency.
